name: Power
overview: Scripture reveals God's power as supreme, glorious, and everlasting, demonstrated from creation when the Spirit of God moved over the waters (Genesis 1:2) to His sovereign control over all flesh and events, such as the plagues in Egypt (Exodus 8:19; 9:3,15). This power is unlimited and able to subdue all things, affirming that nothing is too hard for the Lord (Genesis 18:14). God's power is also manifest in His ability to prevail with men, as seen in the renaming of Jacob to Israel, a prince with power both with God and men (Genesis 32:28).
